Arjun Erigaisi is back in action - this time he is in Montenegro and he is playing for the team of Alkaloid at the European Club Cup 2026. We bring you his round 2 encounter against Iceland's very talented player Vignir Vatnar Stefansson. Commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
